title: Minor influence of climbing hall characteristics on rubber-derived compound contamination highlights a need for material-level solutions
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00812C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Anya Sherman, Laura Lotteraner, Leah K. Maruschka, Thilo Hofmann
Rubber-derived compounds are ubiquitous in climbing halls. Climbing hall design and operational practice explain little variability in rubber-derived compound levels, emphasizing that mitigation needs to occur at the product design level.
